local_market.name: NHB Local Market Size Categories
local_market.description: Standard size and preliminary visual classification for Indian wholesale mandi trade.
local_market.regulatory_note: Local wholesale trade grades primarily on diameter sorting and visible soundness.

missing_requirements: Official mandi Grade A vs URS specifications (NHB local market standard defines size tiers Extra Large/Large/Medium/Small, not Grade A/URS)
Physical diameter calibration in mm (cannot be reliably verified from uncalibrated RGB pixels)
Lot weight data (NAFED/APMC procurement limits are based on weight percentages, not visual image count)

nhb_nasik.name: NHB Export - Nasik / Saurashtra / Bellary / Poona
nhb_nasik.description: National Horticulture Board export standard for globe / round red onions from Maharashtra and Karnataka.
nhb_nasik.regulatory_note: Weight-based regulatory criteria (10% total defect limit) require lot weight data or integration with a weighing system.

missing_requirements: Official export tender Grade A vs URS specifications (NHB export standards define Class I / Class II and decay limits, not Grade A/URS)
Physical diameter calibration in mm (required to certify minimum 20 mm export diameter)

nhb_bangalore.name: NHB Export - Bangalore Rose
nhb_bangalore.description: National Horticulture Board export specification for Bangalore Rose pickled onion variety.
nhb_bangalore.regulatory_note: Smaller diameter requirement (min 15 mm) suited for pickled round rose onions.

missing_requirements: Official export tender Grade A vs URS specifications (NHB export standards define Class I / Class II, not Grade A/URS)
Physical diameter calibration in mm (required to certify minimum 15 mm diameter)

nhb_krishnapuram.name: NHB Export - Krishnapuram
nhb_krishnapuram.description: National Horticulture Board export specification for Andhra Pradesh Krishnapuram variety.
nhb_krishnapuram.regulatory_note: Specific export standard for Krishnapuram pungency and size profile.

missing_requirements: Official export tender Grade A vs URS specifications (NHB export standards define Class I / Class II, not Grade A/URS)
Physical diameter calibration in mm (required to certify minimum 15 mm diameter)

procurement_trial.name: SIH Procurement Trial (Configurable Trial Profile)
procurement_trial.description: SIH demonstration profile. Configurable visual grading criteria for Grade A and URS classification based on surface defect absence and relative sizing.
procurement_trial.regulatory_note: Trial visual grading criteria for procurement screening. Official NAFED/APMC acceptance requires certified scale weight and manual cut verification for internal decay.

grading_criteria.definition_source: Configured trial rule in standards.json based on visual defect segregation and relative sizing; physical mm and weight criteria require calibration and scales.

grade_a.label: Grade A
grade_a.description: Sound bulbs free from any visible decay, sprouting, or splitting, with Medium or Large approximate size.

urs.label: URS (Under Requisite Standard)
urs.description: Bulbs with minor structural defect (double_split) or Small approximate size, but free from rot and sprouting.

defective.label: Defective / Reject
defective.description: Bulbs exhibiting visible surface rot, decay, or emergent vegetative sprouting.

undersized.label: Undersized
undersized.description: Bulbs falling into the Small approximate image-based size category.
